behavior-transform.io.

behavior-transform.io is a local Python wrapper and hook layer for file reads and writes, subprocesses, HTTP fetches, operator input, and MCP traffic. It accepts an I/O request plus an operations or research mode and local text rules, then passes through or transforms the content and returns the requested result with hashes, substitution counts, return codes, or local audit artifacts.
